title: Minimal hidden /wishes admin list with manual refresh and up-to-date declarations

requirements.summary: Replace the /wishes page UI with a minimal admin list that fetches via getAllWishes() and supports manual refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting `/wishes` fetches wishes using the existing backend actor and `getAllWishes()` (no localStorage-based data source).
A "Refresh" button is present and triggers a refetch so new wishes appear without a full page reload.
The page renders a clean list/table of wish text; if timestamps are not available from the backend, only the text is shown.
The page includes basic loading, error, and empty states.

file_operations.description: Replace the current wishes page layout with a minimal admin view: render a simple list/table of wish text, add a visible "Refresh" button that triggers a React Query refetch, and keep basic loading/error/empty states. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Button/Card) where appropriate for consistent styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure `useGetAllWishes()` cleanly exposes refetching behavior (via React Query's returned `refetch`) and continues to fetch through the backend actor's `getAllWishes()` (no local cache/localStorage data source).

requirements.summary: Keep the /wishes admin page hidden from the main gift UI (no navigation link), while remaining reachable by direct URL.
acceptanceCriteria: No new link/button is added on the main `/` gift experience that points to `/wishes`.
Direct navigation to `/wishes` continues to render the wishes admin page.

file_operations.description: Confirm routing continues to render `WishesPage` only when `window.location.pathname === '/wishes'` and ensure the main gift experience does not add any link/button/menu item pointing to `/wishes`.
Verify the main gift experience UI does not contain any navigation element that points to `/wishes`; remove/avoid adding any such link if present.

requirements.summary: Update frontend declarations/bindings to stay consistent with the regenerated backend canister interface.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend builds with up-to-date generated declarations reflecting the backend canister interface.
`useGetAllWishes()` and `useSubmitWish()` continue to typecheck and run against the regenerated declarations.

file_operations.description: Update the frontend actor type declarations to match the regenerated canister interface so `submitWish(text: string): Promise<void>` and `getAllWishes(): Promise<Array<string>>` are correctly represented and `useActor`/React Query hooks continue to typecheck.
Adjust imports/types as needed to align with the updated generated declarations so the actor type remains consistent and the app compiles.
